title: riser (HyperFrames bundle)
description: "riser (HyperFrames bundle)" (Pixabay sound bundled with HyperFrames). Noise/synth riser: audible from ~1.7 s, builds to its top at ~3.0-4.1 s, then cuts off at ~4.2 s; the file then holds ~5.8 s of near-silence (the bundle manifest's '10 s riser, peak at the end' is wrong). Measured: 10.03 s, RMS -14.3 dBFS, -6.6 LUFS, onset 1.67 s, loudest at 3.04 s, audible to 4.4 s, brightness centroid 2715 Hz.
suggested_use: Build into the logo hit: start it ~4.1 s before the hit (not 10 s). Trim the file at 4.4 s.
judged_by: title/tags on the source page plus measured spectrogram and loudness envelope (not auditioned by ear)
